Questions

What does “DevOps: automated deployment and monitoring” cost?

How long does “DevOps: automated deployment and monitoring” take?
The MVP takes 2–4 weeks, the full version 6–12 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Access to servers and accounts; A description of the current system; A technical contact.
